title: Playing house parties around 1927
summary: Playing house parties alongside other pianists such as James Craig, starting around 1927.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, the money wasn't much, but the fun was there, you understand? And they had, uh, at that time about two or three fellas that were doing the same thing. We played house parties. If it wasn't...if it wasn't me, it was Craig. A fella named James Craig. He was a piano player.
But how old were you when you started playing at those parties?
